name: @pipeworx/mcp-htmlentities

tools.name: encode_html
tools.description: Encode text to HTML entities. mode "basic" (default) escapes only & < > " '; mode "extended" also converts every non-ASCII character to a numeric entity. Keyless, offline.

tools.name: decode_html
tools.description: Decode HTML entities (named like & and numeric like © / ©) back to plain text. Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-htmlentities forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the htmlentities pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
